fields.statement: QA cycle 2 at b0e93e8f3: fresh go build -trimpath outside PATH, fake claude and fake rex in an isolated HOME and TMPDIR. rhiza skill check '/rhiza-builder <mode> {leaf}' --permission-mode manual: good 3 of 3, exit 0; bare fails trailers by name, exit 1; quiet fails session-done, exit 1; fail (exits 1) 2 of 3, exit 1. Each launched the builder once and no verifier (earlier qa f1 fixed). --json equals rhiza api call skill.check; uninstalled /rhiza-builder refused naming rhiza guide install --agent claude; empty invoke, bypassPermissions and TMPDIR inside a git repo refused; leaked RHIZA_CHANGE/RHIZA_ACTOR/RHIZA_SKILL_CHECK_ONCE ignored; user repo git status and .rhiza/log unchanged, scratch removed. Rough edge: a pass prints run: failed ... skill not installed (minor finding).

QA cycle 2: rhiza skill check --role verifier: good passes 3 of 3 exit 0, bare fails evidence by name exit 1, no builder session; --role check '/rhiza-check-plan good {check}' passes 3 of 3, bare fails findings and session-done exit 1; --role planner refused; repo unchanged. Defect: a failing check skill launches 3 times, only cycle 1 graded (major finding).

QA cycle 2: rhiza workflow check on every built-in prints no merge warning (earlier qa f2 fixed; plan, plan-milestone, plan-review, ship-change-classic now quiet); build -> test -> merge (gh pr merge) warns naming the step and path in text and --json, exit 0; a merge behind 'cd x && rhiza run gate' is gated. Rough edge: 'echo rhiza ship gate' counts as a gate (minor).

QA cycle 2: a test step with on.fail = build warns in text and --json, exit 0, suggesting handback:build; build -> test(handback:build) -> gate -> merge(on.fail test) no longer warns (earlier qa f3 fixed); ship-change and a workflow from rhiza workflow new raise no loop warning. Rough edge: built-in plan and ship-change-classic raise many loop warnings on max_visits-capped loops (minor).

QA cycle 2: with Rhiza's skills removed from HOME, a leaves workflow warns for the builder and verifier invokes naming the step, role, command and rhiza guide install --agent claude, in text and --json, valid true, exit 0; with the skills installed no warning; a non-Rhiza /rhiza-nosuch agent prompt warns without the install hint.
